stage_designation.quote: This report presents the experimental performance of fan stage 53, another of the fixed-rotor-blade fans in the series. The 30-bladed, 50.8-centimeter-diameter fan was designed for a tip-speed of 302.8 meters per second.

design_pressure_ratio_text.quote: The stage was designed for an overall pressure ratio of 1. 35 at a weight flow of 32. 7 kilograms per second (194. 8 (kg/sec)/m2 of annulus area).

design_weight_flow_text.quote: The stage was designed for an overall pressure ratio of 1. 35 at a weight flow of 32. 7 kilograms per second (194. 8 (kg/sec)/m2 of annulus area).

design_tip_speed_text.quote: The design tip speed was 302. 8 meters per second.

rotor_pressure_distribution.value: rotor-outlet total pressure decreases quadratically from tip to hub
rotor_pressure_distribution.quote: The total pressure at the rotor outlet decreases quadratically from tip to hub. The rotor hub loading decreases further locally where the rotor relative fluid turning is limited to 42. 7° for low noise.

rotor_max_relative_turning.quote: the rotor relative fluid turning is limited to 42. 7° for low noise.

rotor_profile.quote: The rotor and stator have double circular arc blade sections.

stator_profile.quote: The rotor and stator have double circular arc blade sections.

rotor_thickness_to_chord.value: varies cubically from 0.03 at the tip to 0.08 at the hub
rotor_thickness_to_chord.quote: Rotor thickness to chord ratio varies cubically from 0. 03 at the tip to 0. 08 at the hub.

stator_thickness_to_chord.quote: Stator thickness to chord ratio is 0. 08 and is radially constant.

rotor_blade_count.quote: There are 30 rotor blades and 38 stator blades.

stator_blade_count.quote: There are 30 rotor blades and 38 stator blades.

rotor_tip_solidity.quote: The rotor tip solidity is 1. 00, and the stator tip solidity is 1.27.

stator_tip_solidity.quote: The rotor tip solidity is 1. 00, and the stator tip solidity is 1.27.

rotor_aspect_ratio.quote: Rotor aspect ratio is 2. 86, and stator aspect ratio is 2. 62 based on the chord length at the mean blade height.

stator_aspect_ratio.quote: Rotor aspect ratio is 2. 86, and stator aspect ratio is 2. 62 based on the chord length at the mean blade height.

rotor_stator_spacing.value: rotor-hub TE to stator-hub LE = four times the rotor hub chord (axial projection)
rotor_stator_spacing.quote: For low noise the spacing between the rotor trailing edge and the stator leading edge was made equal to four times the axial projection of the rotor blade chord at the hub. ... The axial spacing between the rotor-hub trailing edge and the stator-hub leading edge was four times the rotor hub chord.

rotor_tip_clearance_cold.quote: The nonrotating radial tip clearance of the rotor was a nominal 0. 050 centimeter at ambient conditions.

part_span_damper.quote: (no damper is mentioned anywhere in the text)

blade_element_surfaces.value: conical surfaces approximating stream surfaces; stacked on a radial line about their centers of gravity
blade_element_surfaces.quote: the blade coordinate subprogram (ref. 16) is used to compute the blade elements on conical surfaces approximating the stream surfaces passing through the blade. The program then stacks these blade elements on a radial line about their centers of gravity

survey_stations.value: station 1 upstream of rotor, 2 between rotor and stator, 3 downstream of stator; axial positions Z = -2.408, 7.727, 32.492 cm (Fig. 1 footnote 'a' Survey planes); 9 radial positions
survey_stations.quote: Radial surveys of the flow were made upstream of the rotor, between the rotor and stator, and downstream of the stator (fig. 1). ... Data were recorded at nine radial positions for each speed and weight flow.

stator_passage_traverse.quote: The combination probe downstream of the stator (station 3) was circumferentially traversed one stator blade passage (9. 5°) counterclockwise from the nominal value shown.

data_translated_to_blade_edges.quote: The data, measured at the three measuring stations, were translated to the rotor and stator blade leading and trailing edges by the method presented in reference 14.

z_reference.quote: Z axial distance referenced from rotor blade hub leading edge, cm

zi_definition.value: axial distance from inlet hub to blade leading edge
zi_definition.quote: ZI axial distance from inlet hub to blade leading edge, cm

percent_span_definition.value: percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet
percent_span_definition.quote: PERCENT SPAN percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet

angle_convention_beta.value: air angle between air velocity and axial direction
angle_convention_beta.quote: β air angle, angle between air velocity and axial direction, deg

angle_convention_kappa.value: angle between blade mean camber line and meridional plane
angle_convention_kappa.quote: κ angle between blade mean camber line and meridional plane, deg

setting_angle_definition.value: angle between aerodynamic chord and meridional plane
setting_angle_definition.quote: SETTING ANGLE angle between aerodynamic chord and meridional plane, deg

cone_angle_definition.value: angle between axial direction and conical surface representing blade element
cone_angle_definition.quote: CONE ANGLE angle between axial direction and conical surface representing blade element, deg

turn_rate_definition.value: ratio of change in blade angle per unit path distance for front segment to that for aft segment
turn_rate_definition.quote: TURN RATE ratio of change in blade angle per unit path distance for front blade segment to the change in blade angle per unit path distance for aft blade segment

choke_margin_definition.value: ratio of actual flow area minus critical area to critical area
choke_margin_definition.quote: CHOKE MARGIN ratio of actual flow area minus critical area to critical area (where local Mach number is 1)

standard_conditions.quote: ratio of rotor-inlet total pressure to standard pressure of 10.13 N/cm2 ... ratio of rotor-inlet total temperature to standard temperature of 288.2 K

cp_gamma.quote: C specific heat at constant pressure, 1004 J/kg/K ... γ ratio of specific heats (1.40)

test_speeds.quote: The stage survey data were taken over a range of weight flows from maximum flow to the near-stall at speeds of 70, 80, 90, 100, and 120 percent of design.
